_comment: The single source of Faida design tokens. Edit here, then run `npm run tokens` from the repo root. Palette: Faida Blue #1F6BFF and Faida Navy #0A2A55 on Cloud #F3F6FC, with Faida Orange #F26A0C as the accent (from the Faida POS logo).

navy._comment: Faida Navy: the logo wordmark. Top bars, dark panels, headings that carry the brand.

accent._comment: Faida Orange: the stroke in the logo. Accents only (a highlight, a badge, a PIN dot); never body text on white (3.2:1). Text in orange uses the text shade.

statusShades._comment: Tailwind's stock 600 shades of these families are under 4.5:1 on white, and pages use them for text. These replace them.

statusSolid._comment: Backgrounds that carry white text: the 400/500 fills of these families are too light for 4.5:1, so the utilities use these instead.

brandText._comment: Brand-coloured TEXT (text-blue-600 etc.). Faida Blue itself is 4.1:1 on the lightest brand tint, so text uses this deeper shade on light surfaces.

statusText._comment: Status colours as TEXT on a tint of themselves (badges, pills) and as fills under white text. Tailwind-style 600 shades are 4.0-4.4:1 on their own 12% tint, so the admin console and landing site use these.
